{{actor|name=ovl_En_Torch|ispage=true}}

'''ovl_En_Torch''' is a special [[actor]] that spawns an instance of {{actor ref|000A}} within a specific [[grottos|grotto]]. The information is passed in by actor {{actor ref|009B}}.

{{clear}}

== NTSC 1.0 Notes ==

===Relative to rom===

0xE9A550 - List of chest contents. See [[Get Items]]


===Relative to Save Start===
Save start is 11A5D0

0x1397 - Byte where chest contents and chest flag is stored. & E0 = Contents, & 1F = flags
